source.section: Decision 26 alternatives considered -- retain-without-robustness-check rejection rationale

claims.claim_text: it does not use the ensemble confidence signal (vote counts) during clustering, operates on centroid distance rather than spatial overlap (IoU), and produces duplicate candidates for ~11.6 % of ground-truth mounds due to centroid drift exceeding the 20 m radius. A reviewer familiar with the modern object-detection literature would ask about these issues, and a post-hoc robustness check is the right response.

values.quantity: percentage of ground-truth mounds receiving duplicate candidate detections due to centroid drift exceeding the greedy-ball clustering radius (audit finding, Obs 228)
centroid-distance radius, greedy-ball consensus clustering (restated as context for the duplicate-candidate finding)

claims.notes: The ~11.6% duplicate-candidate figure is attributed to 'the audit process (Obs 228)' in the surrounding text; Obs 228 is an observation-log identifier, out of scope per rule 5, and no other artefact naming this percentage is visible from within this document (rule 7) -- left anchor-unknown for triage. Approx marker '~' retained verbatim per v1.2 amendment 5. The 20 m radius restates the clustering-distance threshold already anchored to scripts/lib_consensus.py's `DISTANCE_THRESHOLD_METRES` constant in the preceding claim.

source.section: Decision 26 rationale item 1 -- registered clustering algorithm (D17 audit correction)

claims.claim_text: The preregistration **does** specify the clustering algorithm: §8.5 step 4 registers **greedy clustering at 20 m** by name as a seven-step procedure (`osf/preregistration.md:1875-1885`, "Greedy clustering: for each unclustered detection, find all others within 20m and matching label; group as cluster")

values.quantity: greedy clustering distance, as specified in the registration (Section 8.5, paraphrase 'greedy clustering at 20 m')
step count of the registered greedy-clustering spatial-clustering-algorithm procedure (Section 8.5)
greedy clustering distance, as specified in the registration (Section 8.5, verbatim quoted spec text 'find all others within 20m')

claims.notes: v1.1 calibration rule: a claim about what the REGISTRATION specifies anchors to the lodged osf document, not the executed script. osf/preregistration.md's 'Spatial Clustering Algorithm' subsection (Section 8.5 region) lists exactly seven numbered steps; step 4 reads 'Cluster detections using distance threshold matching the F1 evaluation tolerance (20m): ... Greedy clustering: for each unclustered detection, find all others within 20m and matching label; group as cluster' -- confirming both the 20 m distance and the seven-step count (section located and file confirmed to exist per rule 4; not value-adjudicated). The line-number citation 'osf/preregistration.md:1875-1885' and the identifiers 'D17'/'FALSE-13'/section number 'Section 8.5'/'step 4' are excluded from values per rule 5 (line-number citations, audit identifiers, and section/step reference numbers).
